-- TEMPORARY GIFT AUDIO MOVEMENT/STATE OBSERVER
task.spawn(function()
 local H=game:GetService("HttpService");local q={events={}};local seen={};local moved=false
 for i=1,2000 do
  local now=server.clock.utcNowMs()
  for id,session in server.players do
   local p=activePlayerObjects[id];if not p or not p.Character then continue end
   if not moved then p.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,4,-12));moved=true end
   local snap=session.coordinator.snapshots();local profile=snap.working or snap.durable
   for gid,g in profile.rewards.droneSpawns or {} do
    local row=seen[gid]
    if not row then row={};seen[gid]=row;table.insert(q.events,{kind="spawn",id=gid,landed=g.landedAtMs,at=now}) end
    if not row.walk and now>=g.landedAtMs+500 then row.walk=true;p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):MoveTo(Vector3.new(g.position.x,3,g.position.z));table.insert(q.events,{kind="walk",id=gid,at=now}) end
    if g.claimed and not row.claim then row.claim=true;table.insert(q.events,{kind="claimed",id=gid,at=now,reward=g.reward,cash=profile.farm.cash}) end
   end
  end
  script:SetAttribute("GiftAudioQA",H:JSONEncode(q));task.wait(.05)
 end
end)

 end)
